status: AI-generated working labels. NOT human-verified, NOT gold, NOT adjudicated. Authorised by the project owner as the working supervision source while human annotations are unavailable.

stance.guidelines: reports/annotation_guidelines_v1.1.md (stance toward Open Government; criticism alone never Oppose; French labelled with the standard rules by a French-reading labeller, section 7)

pilot_50.method: pre-existing AI-assisted draft designated primary; reused unchanged (no merge, no vote)

expansion_350.method: single-pass AI labelling by Claude (model id claude-opus-5-5) inside a Claude Code session, reading each text with its question slug and source language and applying the v1.1 decision order (understandable? -> off-topic -> position). One label per record, no second pass, no human review.
expansion_350.prompt_version: guidelines v1.1 decision order + section 5 special cases; session instruction 'AI-label the 350 expansion_v2 records under guidelines v1.1' (2026-10-14)
expansion_350.consistency_adjustments: expansion_v2_283 and expansion_v2_345 (session praise) set to Neutral to match draft 1's treatment of thanks/session praise

sentiment.construct: tone of the text (Positive / Negative / Neutral / Mixed); independent of stance. Negative tone does not imply Oppose.
sentiment.method: same labeller and pass as the expansion stance labels; pilot sentiment labelled in the same session (no prior sentiment draft existed)

known_limitations: single AI labeller per record; no inter-annotator agreement exists or can be computed from these labels
pilot stance labels and expansion labels come from different AI passes
Oppose has very few records and Mixed none; these classes cannot be trained or evaluated
labels are judgements about guideline application and may encode systematic AI bias
